caption: The drawing features a single object centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a rust-colored metal implement with a flat, elongated oval shape, open at the top with three equally spaced crossbars inside its frame. Attached to one end of the frame is a straight handle, also rust-colored, which terminates in a small loop. The opposite end of the frame has two downward-curving legs and a shorter perpendicular extension. The overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the object with no additional elements or decorations around it. There is a faint signature in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Stand
